policies.title: Account deletion reaches every table holding user data
policies.statement: Every table with a field that links to the users table must be reached by a function, endpoint or task that deletes records from it, so that deleting a user account also removes the user's data everywhere it is held. A table whose rows must be kept for a legal reason, such as invoices or orders, is exempted by its owner, who must also decide whether those rows are anonymised instead.

policies.title: Retained data has a cleanup task
policies.statement: Every table carrying the retained-data tag is referenced by a scheduled task that cleans it up. Personal data is kept no longer than the retention period (two years for customer data), and the task must delete or anonymise the expired records. A table that must be kept longer is exempted by its owner, not by a tag added here.
